all_versions.rule_sl: Zadnje verzije kažejo, kaj imamo; vse verzije kažejo, koliko smo med testi nadgrajevali. Identične kopije so štete enkrat; .py v arhivih .zip/.7z niso šteti (spodnja meja).
all_versions.rule_en: Latest versions show what we have; all versions show how much we upgraded between tests. Identical copies are counted once; .py files inside .zip/.7z archives are not counted (lower bound).
notes: HOME: page-consistent variant (page Python baseline + older versions passing the census content gates; gitleaks not run on older versions)
WORK: sha256-unique across all WORK projects; .py inside .zip/.7z not opened
top lists: names and numbers only; HOME older_versions = distinct older .py versions; WORK variant_containers = version/archive folders and version tags (+1 main line), as defined by the WORK census
